text:
jordan: Quick preflight check — RC cutoff is in ~2 hours (18:00 PT). Please get final PRs merged or flagged for the next train. I'll kick off the canary at 16:30 PT and post an announce draft to #announcements once canary is green. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: On it. Canary job queued now (canary-rc3). Running 2 nodes with smoke + basic load tests. Will report failures here.

release-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-rc3 -> aws-us-west-2 (2 nodes). ID: cb-1968501234

ci-bot: CI status: 19/20 pipelines passing. api-integration failing on flaky test 'payment-retry'. Failure is intermittent. Logs: https://ci.redwood/1968/job/4321

liam: I'm on the failing test — pushing a tiny tweak to retry logic in 10–15m. If it still flakes, can we allow a short exception for this branch?

jordan: If it's a small retry fix that doesn't change public API, include it. If it's larger, we'll hold for next RC. Ping me and @maya when you push.

liam: pushed: branch release/rc3/fix-payment-retry -> PR #1489. Tests re-running.

ci-bot: PR #1489 pipeline: rerun started.

maya: Canary smoke passed initial checks. Waiting for integration tests (will take ~12m).

release-bot: Canary deploy succeeded: canary-rc3 -> green. Smoke + basic load within expected ranges.

sophia: Product confirms version bump to v3.2.0 and approves changelog entries for the feature-set. FYI we'll call out the optimized batching behavior in the announce.

alex: Changelog draft is up: https://git.redwood/changelogs/v3.2.0.md (PR #1492). Please add one-line notes if you want specific callouts.

jordan: Draft for #announcements (first pass):
```
Redwood Inference — v3.2.0 (RC)
Deploying today: optimizations for batching/kv-caching, reduced tail latency for long-context models, and a few bug fixes.
Canary green. Production rollout starting at 17:00 PT. Full notes: <link to changelog>
```
Will refine and post once CI fully green. @alex can you shorten for social?

alex: Yep, I'll trim for the announcement and add CTA to upgrade guides.

taylor: Heads up from Dedicated infra — there's a planned maintenance window tomorrow at 02:00 PT that might overlap if the rollout continues. If we go longer than planned, we need to coordinate to avoid double-impact.

jordan: Noted. I'll include a line about the maintenance window and fallback to previous stable (v3.1.4) if we see any significant regressions.

ci-bot: All pipelines now passing. PR #1489 merged.

liam: thanks — green on my side.

maya: Canary metrics attached: p50/p95/p99 within targets. Uploading graphs to the release thread.

jordan: OK — posting to #announcements at 17:05 PT with the shortened copy. If anything slips I'll update here and ping the lead channel. Everyone please thumbs-up on the announce copy if you're good. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:

sophia: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

maya: :thumbsup:

jordan: Thanks all — closing preflight. If issues show in early rollout, we'll run the rollback plan (automated fallback to v3.1.4, rollback key: RB-1968).
